title: Spontaneously charged water drops induce corrosion.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: open-access full text present; no accessions in text, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI dataset links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint timed out at 120 s (one attempt, not retried), so supplement not retrievable.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Data availability says data are in the paper, Extended Data, Supplementary Information and per-figure Source Data files. The study is physical chemistry: charged water drops sliding over insulators and breaking down coatings on metal.

a1_downloadable.note: No repository deposit; only Nature per-figure Source Data files, and the Europe PMC supplement listing timed out. Not checked in files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No modelling table exists; any label (coating breakdown or corrosion yes/no) would have to be assembled from per-figure source data of individual experiments. Paper text only.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be experimental settings (drop charge, surface, coating) scattered across figures; no feature table described.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked; source data not opened.

a5_enough_rows.note: A bench physics study of a handful of surface and coating conditions; far below 400 labelled rows by the nature of the experiments (count not verified).

a6_fits_laptop.note: Source data tables would be tiny.

a8_label_provenance.note: Labels would be direct measurements (voltage, current, corrosion imaging), not model output.

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: No biological identifiers to join on.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: this is a small physical-chemistry experiment, not a biology dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use drop charge, surface type and coating properties to predict whether a coated metal breaks down and corrodes.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-experiment settings from the paper's figure source data; number of examples unknown and likely tens.
plain_idea.predict: Whether the coating broke down or corrosion appeared, as measured in the authors' bench experiments.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Corrosion engineers might care, but this is materials science outside the biology-only scope, and the data are too few to model.

ml_idea: None viable: off-topic (physical chemistry of charged drops and corrosion) and only per-figure source data from a small number of bench experiments.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected before any table could be built.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Topic is not biology; no check needed beyond reading the abstract.

verdict_reason: Not biology (physical chemistry of corrosion), no deposited dataset, and only small per-figure source data from a few bench experiments; fails A1, A2, A5.
